name: Qualcomm Cloud AI 100 Ultra, vLLM: DeepSeek-R1-70B peak aggregate tok/s (arXiv:2507.00418)
unit: tok/s aggregate (peak over 32-256 concurrent requests; 1 card)
methodology: THIRD-PARTY MEASURED (arXiv:2507.00418, PEARC'25, UCSD/NRP). vLLM serving, concurrency swept across 32/64/128/256 simultaneous requests dispatched via ThreadPoolExecutor to a local vLLM API; value is the PEAK AGGREGATE tokens/sec across the sweep (Table 2). Median latency/throughput computed per request set; coefficient of variation <5%. QAic = Cloud AI 100 Ultra, 1 card = 4 SoC. AGGREGATE throughput across concurrent requests, NOT per-request decode tok/s.
notes: Peak aggregate figure from a concurrency sweep — reads much higher than a single-stream decode rate and must not be compared to per-request tok/s. QAic QPC compile path (ONNX->QPC) is hardware-specific; numbers reflect the compiled deployment, not a naive run.
